name: Stone Titan
primary:
A giant stone titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either hurls boulders that shatter within 2.2 blocks: damage 6 ❤ earth, knockback;
or slams the ground with both fists, which heaves the ground in a mound; everyone within 5 blocks takes 6 ❤ earth and is stunned for 1.5 s.
self_description:
On you:
• Stone skin (resistance III), 20 s
